articles.title: Ipswich sign Argentina World Cup winner Palacios
articles.summary: Argentina midfielder Exequiel Palacios becomes the first World Cup winner to sign for Ipswich Town after joining from Bayer Leverkusen.

articles.title: York Knights takeover by new local group revealed
articles.summary: York Knights have confirmed that a "locally-based ownership group" has agreed to take over a majority share of the club.
